2Ti.2.26.bsb: Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.
2Ti.2.26.kjv: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

2Ti.2.10.bsb: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
2Ti.2.10.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

2Ti.2.8.bsb: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel,
2Ti.2.8.kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

2Ti.2.22.bsb: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
2Ti.2.22.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

2Ti.1.16.bsb: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
2Ti.1.16.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

2Ti.1.17.bsb: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.
2Ti.1.17.kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

2Ti.1.18.bsb: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
2Ti.1.18.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

2Ti.4.16.bsb: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
2Ti.4.16.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

2Ti.3.6.bsb: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
2Ti.3.6.kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

2Ti.1.8.bsb: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
2Ti.1.8.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

2Ti.2.12.bsb: if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;
2Ti.2.12.kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

2Ti.4.10.bsb: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
2Ti.4.10.kjv: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

2Ti.1.15.bsb: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
2Ti.1.15.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

2Ti.3.2.bsb: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
2Ti.3.2.kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

2Ti.3.7.bsb: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
2Ti.3.7.kjv: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

2Ti.3.15.bsb: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
2Ti.3.15.kjv: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

2Ti.1.5.bsb: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
2Ti.1.5.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

2Ti.2.3.bsb: Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
2Ti.2.3.kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

2Ti.4.7.bsb: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
2Ti.4.7.kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

2Ti.1.6.bsb: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
2Ti.1.6.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

2Ti.4.2.bsb: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
2Ti.4.2.kjv: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

2Ti.4.20.bsb: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.
2Ti.4.20.kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

2Ti.2.5.bsb: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
2Ti.2.5.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

2Ti.4.8.bsb: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.
2Ti.4.8.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

2Ti.1.10.bsb: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
2Ti.1.10.kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

2Ti.4.6.bsb: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
2Ti.4.6.kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

2Ti.1.12.bsb: For this reason, even though I suffer as I do, I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day.
2Ti.1.12.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

2Ti.2.11.bsb: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;
2Ti.2.11.kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

2Ti.2.13.bsb: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.
2Ti.2.13.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

2Ti.1.13.bsb: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
2Ti.1.13.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

2Ti.2.1.bsb: You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
2Ti.2.1.kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

2Ti.4.18.bsb: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
2Ti.4.18.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

2Ti.2.19.bsb: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
2Ti.2.19.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

2Ti.1.9.bsb: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
2Ti.1.9.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

2Ti.1.7.bsb: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
2Ti.1.7.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

2Ti.1.14.bsb: Guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
2Ti.1.14.kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

2Ti.4.1.bsb: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
2Ti.4.1.kjv: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

2Ti.4.14.bsb: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
2Ti.4.14.kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

2Ti.4.15.bsb: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.
2Ti.4.15.kjv: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

2Ti.2.15.bsb: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
2Ti.2.15.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

2Ti.2.16.bsb: But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
2Ti.2.16.kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

2Ti.3.16.bsb: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
2Ti.3.16.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

2Ti.2.25.bsb: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
2Ti.2.25.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

2Ti.2.20.bsb: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.
2Ti.2.20.kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

2Ti.2.4.bsb: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.
2Ti.2.4.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

2Ti.2.21.bsb: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
2Ti.2.21.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.

2Ti.2.23.bsb: But reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.
2Ti.2.23.kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

2Ti.2.24.bsb: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
2Ti.2.24.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

2Ti.3.13.bsb: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
2Ti.3.13.kjv: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

2Ti.2.14.bsb: Remind the believers of these things, charging them before God to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.
2Ti.2.14.kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

2Ti.1.3.bsb: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
2Ti.1.3.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

2Ti.4.4.bsb: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
2Ti.4.4.kjv: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

2Ti.3.8.bsb: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
2Ti.3.8.kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

2Ti.2.9.bsb: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!
2Ti.2.9.kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

2Ti.3.17.bsb: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
2Ti.3.17.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

2Ti.4.3.bsb: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
2Ti.4.3.kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

2Ti.3.9.bsb: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.
2Ti.3.9.kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
